verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents incremental sync modes, cursor-based state tracking, and CDC log-based replication that pull only changed/new records since the last sync, directly matching the story. However, community evidence shows edge cases requiring manual workarounds (e.g., a user had to 'trick' Airbyte into treating a large table as already synced) and an open question about whether hard deletes are reliably captured in incremental mode, indicating state/cursor handling isn't always seamless. missing for 10: independent confirmation that hard-deletes and large-table edge cases are handled without manual intervention, and clearer docs addressing the raised hard-delete question.
